interpretation: Rename effect (v2 vs v3): 0/24 vs 0/24 invocation-positive. The intuitive name did not restore uptake in these replays.
Argument effect (v3 vs v4): 0/24 vs 0/24, zero focus questions asked, zero protocol violations. The focus argument did not restore uptake either.
Models never emitted anything but bash and never violated the argument contract; non-use is not confusion about the schema.
Combined with prior work: 0/60 on v2 plus 0/48 on v3/v4 across the same states. The decision gap is deeper than naming and argument affordance.
Repetitions are resamples of two fixed caller states at configured defaults, not independent tasks; no benchmark reward measured; no performance claim.
